name: acne-point-filter-protocol
status: fixed before any point-filter number is computed; one version, one comparison

ruleTable.old: box clipped to raster; rejected only if the clipped box is empty (OUTSIDE_SOURCE_SUPPORT); centre clamped to raster edge
ruleTable.new: point not finite / outside image -> reject; no clamping

ruleTable.old: box overlapping the raster may pass with clamped centre
ruleTable.new: point outside the raster (visible-region scope) -> POINT_OUTSIDE_SCOPE

ruleTable.old: centre on exclusion OR exclusion fraction of box > .25
hair fraction of box > .25 (dense) ; centre on hair -> redness/contrast rescue if box skin >= .50
centre not skin -> rescue; box skin fraction < .50 -> reject
largest envelope&skin overlap fraction of the box >= .15, else distance fallback (midline, .15 fw)
ruleTable.new: envelope membership of the point (first in REGIONS order), else the same distance fallback

inputs: pre-filter predictions only: Step0 recorded NMS boxes (trace), external stored final boxes before filter; same recomputed product masks/geometry as the parity-checked staging run; no review/ground-truth mask as input
parityFirst: old path must reproduce Step0 71/108 F96 D48, Dewiin 75/108 F45 D3, tristan-gray 71/108 F58 D1, carsten12 43/108 F16 D0
scoring: unchanged common scope (108 in-scope targets, frozen reviewed masks, r = 0.03 fw, one-to-one); removed targets stay in the denominator; Clear 14 photos separately (Step0 has no Clear pre-filter records)
